Not much of note has happened this week. I've just been keeping to my routine of running and weightlifting. My average daily caloric intake during the week was 1447 cal. I met my goal of consuming between than 1200-1800 cal each day except for two days. One was 1820, the other was 1158. At least the over day was on a lifting day and the under was on a rest day.

According to my logging site, I've used 6492 more cal than I ate for the week. This should translate to 1.8 lbs. of real weight lose.

I went for a run twice times this week. I did a 5k for one of those runs and finished in 34:47. I just walked for an hour the other day since my stomach was giving me issues. I managed to go 4.1 miles during this hour. I also lifted weights twice this week. I completed 2 days of Stronglifts, most with a empty or near empty bar. I still need to practice the barbell row. My squat, bench press, and overhead press feel pretty good. My deadlift could also use some more work.

Failures:

* Went outside my calorie limits on two days.

The Half Mudder is now 12 weeks away. My goals for it are to be able to run 5 miles in an hour without feeling terrible, and to be able to perform 5 reps of pull-ups and dips. As my body fat goes down, these should become easier. I want to be able to run a 5k in 30 minutes by the end of March.

I feel pretty good about meetings my 5 miles in a hour goal considering I did over 4 miles with an upset stomach. I hope to beat this goal in a week or 2. I have been using an assisted pull-up/dips machine on running days for a set of 5 each. Each week I complete a set, I set the weight lower and now I'm down to 48 lbs assist. It'll be a while before I can do unassisted pull-ups but I think I'll make that goal in April.
Week 7. Good. CW 178.4, down 1.1lbs this week, down 21.6lbs total.
